title: WaterSound Crossings "Home Run" A-104 - 429 Bridge Lane
h1: WaterSound Crossings "Home Run" A-104 - 429 Bridge Lane
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Gated Community with on-site Security- Great views of the Gulf and natural sand dunes- Fantastic porch spaces- Pool and beach are just yards away- Electric vehicle charging station- Newly Renovated with fresh furniture and Appliances- 3 adult bikes- From March 1st to October 31st, the rental of this property includes one beach -service set (2 beach chairs and 1umbrella)- Private deeded beach access- Free WiFi- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkout *This property comes with 2 designated parking spaces. This condo permits a maximum of 2 vehicles through the community security gate.*Beginning in March 2025 and continuing through 2026, the WaterSound Crossings condominiums will undergo an extensive exterior refurbishment project. During this period, residents and guests should expect significant construction activity, including the boarding of windows and restricted access to balconies in affected buildings. These measures are necessary to ensure safety and facilitate the successful completion of the work.DETAILS: 104A is a spectacular beach front unit in WaterSound Crossings, making this an unforgettable vacation location! This fantastic three bedroom, three and a half bath Condo is sure to please! With its sophisticated finishes and amazing ocean views, this will be your perfect vacation retreat. When entering the second floor of the Condo, you will be welcomed by the great room, beautiful hardwood floors and phenomenal Gulf views. You will also be able to enjoy meals prepared in the fantastic kitchen. There, you will experience the stainless steel appliances with a Viking gas stove, granite counter tops and stunning cabinetry. The relaxing living room, well-appointed dining room and astounding kitchen are all included in this open floor plan for everyone to enjoy after a fun-filled day at the beach. What a perfect end to a perfect day! Down the hall, you will encounter two bedrooms with Queen beds and connecting bathrooms. Both rooms will definitely give you that vacation retreat you were looking for! You will also find a Primary Bedroom with a King bed on the first floor with a connecting bathroom that offers a double vanity, separate shower and jetted tub, along with two large closets. Lastly, there is a bunk area which makes it perfect for the kids! This Condo has ample indoor space and outdoor patio and balcony space, where you will be able to enjoy gulf views or catch an amazing sunset. This truly is a great gathering spot for everyone to spend time together, making a memorable vacation!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (Sleeps 8) FIRST FLOOR: - Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom With Shower/Tub- Bunk Room: Twin over Twin bunk bedsSECOND FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower OnlyAMENITIES INCLUDE: Community Pool, and Gulf views. Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers are laundered upon every checkout.* Due to HOA rules guests will not be able to rent Low-Speed Vehicles and will not be able to bring their own Low-Speed Vehicle.*Weddings or parties/groups of people or guest of guest are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments and be subject to HOA, community, and 360 Blue fines.
